opening.argument: The presentation ties an upfront financial commitment—a $7,810 share and membership fee—to claimed daily payments, passive income, and withdrawals. The speaker presents mining packages as producing payments and says, “Passive income is charged every day,” while adding, “And you can withdraw money, too, at least every day.” It directs viewers to an external signup destination promising cryptocurrency earnings “safely and easily,” and describes proceeds being reinvested into equipment to increase income. Although profitability may rise if Bitcoin increases, that qualification does not remove the asserted connection between paying upfront and receiving returns.
